description: ChitChat — anonymous 1-to-1 stranger chat. Talk to someone you've never met.
name: chitchat

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@chitchat/server && npm run build --workspace=@chitchat/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@chitchat/web && npm run lint --workspace=@chitchat/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@chitchat/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@chitchat/web
